decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app is close to the core practice software, was launched as a new product line with its own page, and fits the digitalization trend, so a growing firm with slack has no performance shortfall prompting it to drop it.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and customer relationships at low marginal cost, and with the firm growing there is no aspiration gap that would trigger problemistic search to reallocate its resources.
The remote screen-sharing tool supports the firm's core customer service efficiently and is cheap to maintain, so the growing firm's slack makes keeping it the satisficing choice.
